refusal_reason: Image-only Google Books scan: 209 of 210 pages yield no extractable text via pymupdf get_text() (total ~2940 characters across the whole file, essentially all from the Google digitization/usage boilerplate on page 1; sampled body pages 10/50/100/150/210 return 0 characters).
